editor.label: OPKSSH
editor.description: Acesse este host usando seu provedor de identidade em vez de uma senha ou chave. Requer que o OPKSSH esteja configurado no servidor.

dialog.title: OPKSSH Authentication Required
dialog.description: Complete authentication in your browser to continue. This session will remain valid for 24 hours.

errors.authFailed: Authentication failed. Please check your credentials and try again.
errors.timeout: Authentication timed out. Please try again.

redirectUri.label: Redirect URI
redirectUri.description: Register this URL as an allowed redirect URI with every identity provider in your OPKSSH config.

legacyCallback.label: Use the old redirect URI
legacyCallback.description: Keep sending /host/opkssh-callback, the redirect URI used before 2.9. Turn this off once your identity providers allow the new one.
